positions.name: PallasineChecklistAuthority
positions.frame: how is the Pallasine checklist established as the authoritative onboarding process?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere under a shared read of the Pallasine checklist as an institutional mandate: src-1 performs the universal rule (every new hire, first week, three named components) while src-2 grounds its authority through institutional supersession (replaced the old wiki page last quarter). The conviction gradient — decision-grade rule in src-1 against claim-grade history in src-2 — is appropriate tension: the process is stated as settled operational fact, and its lineage is asserted as historical fact, both serving the same question of how the checklist's authority is constituted.
